title: 第13章 Tree的采访首秀
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

此时的采访席上，骆歆正握着话筒站在灯光下。

她的眼神里同样闪烁着兴奋的光芒，毕竟今天这场对局的剧本放在整个常规赛里都属于绝对的收视率炸弹：濒死豪门的绝境变阵、无人问津的替补神兵天降、直接把大名鼎鼎的韩式窒息流运营打到道心崩溃。

这种拉满的话题度，观众喜欢，主持人作为LPL的直接利益相关方同样喜欢。

“好，导播镜头切过来了。让我们欢迎Tree来到我们的采访席！”

随着骆歆的开场白，主舞台的大屏幕上放大了陈周的半身特写。

清爽的碎发配上红白配色的LGD队服，脸上还带着几分没有褪干净的学生气，看上去给人自然而然地生出好感来。

“终于不是反向Q的痘痘脸了。”

“这新人打得怎样先不谈，这长相还真不错。”

“现在这只新LGD，也就Eimy颜值差点，Eimy到时候跟着韩国老大哥去首尔整个容，直接顶替EDG天团出道。”

“长得这么清秀，结果在游戏里是个开天眼的不当人打法，反差萌了属于是。”

“完了兄弟们，感觉韦神回不来了啊，这Tree吸女粉可比godv容易太多。”

“怎么还哭了呢？赢了也哭？又一个洗澡狗？”

骆歆侧过身子，将手里的话筒往陈周的方向递了递，脸上笑容更甚，采访帅哥明显要更开心：

“今天也是你第一次真正登上LPL的职业舞台，在采访正式开始前，先跟台下还有直播间的粉丝朋友们打个热情的招呼吧。”

话筒递到面前的瞬间，陈周的眼神有过些许恍惚。

太久了。

这刺眼的聚光灯，这反光的镜头玻璃，比赛场馆弥漫着的热情。

那些在浑浑噩噩的岁月里被他判定为这辈子都再难企及的东西，此刻真实地呈现在他面前，触手可及。

短暂的沉默后，他没有像其他新人那样紧张，只是对着麦克风点了点头。

“大家好，我是LGD的中单，Tree。”

台下的LGD粉丝方阵极其给面子地爆发出掌声。

骆歆顺势抛出了准备好的第一个常规问题，笑着问道：“今天是你来到LPL的首秀，而且一上来就帮助在低谷中的队伍二比零干净利落地战胜了强敌VG，打破了连败。现在站在这个舞台上，你现在的心情是怎么样的？可以跟我们分享一下吗？”

陈周没有任何多余的停顿，握着话筒，内心已经恢复了平静：“我觉得很开心，能赢下这场比赛，它会让我觉得，我在英雄联盟职业选手这条道路上的坚持是值得的。”

场馆内的空气安静了半秒，随后台下不知道是哪个战队的男粉丝带头开始鼓掌，掌声不是很热烈，但很清晰。

付出努力获得回报，这样的故事在哪里都不过时。

人们之所以喜欢听这样的故事，是因为在现实里，这往往是一件奢侈品。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At this time, in the interview booth, Luo Xin was standing under the light with a microphone in his hand.

Her eyes were also shining with excitement. After all, the script of today's game was an absolute ratings bomb in the entire regular season: a desperate change of formation by a dying giant, a substitute that no one cared about came from the sky, and the famous Korean suffocation operation was directly hit to the point of collapse.

The audience likes this kind of buzz, and the host, as a direct stakeholder of LPL, also likes it.

"Okay, the director's camera has cut over. Let's welcome Tree to our interview booth!"

Following Luo Xin's opening remarks, a close-up of Chen Zhou's body was zoomed in on the big screen on the main stage.

With his fresh broken hair and the red and white LGD team uniform, and a bit of student energy on his face that has not faded away, he looks like someone who naturally likes him.

"Finally, I no longer have a reverse Q acne face."

"Let's not talk about how this new guy is playing. He looks really good."

"Now the new LGD is only inferior to Eimy in terms of appearance. Eimy will go to Seoul with Big Brother Korea to get a facelift and directly replace EDG to debut."

"She looks so pretty, but in the game, she is a very open-minded person who doesn't play well with others. In contrast, she is cute."

"It's over, brothers. I feel like Wei Shen will never come back. It's much easier for Tree to attract female fans than godv."

"Why are you still crying? Crying even after winning? Another bathing dog?"

Luo Xin turned sideways and handed the microphone in his hand to Chen Zhou. The smile on his face became even wider. He was obviously happier interviewing the handsome guy:

"Today is also your first time on the LPL professional stage. Before the interview officially begins, please give a warm hello to the fans and friends in the audience and in the live broadcast room."

The moment the microphone was handed to him, Chen Zhou's eyes were a little dazed.

Too long.

This dazzling spotlight, this reflective lens glass, the competition venue is filled with enthusiasm.

Those things that he had judged to be unattainable in this life in his confused years were now truly present in front of him and within reach.

After a brief silence, he was not as nervous as other newcomers, and just nodded into the microphone.

"Hello everyone, I am LGD's mid laner, Tree."

The phalanx of LGD fans in the audience burst into applause out of dignity.

Luo Xin took advantage of the situation and asked the first regular question he prepared, and asked with a smile: "Today is your first show in the LPL, and right from the start, you helped the team in the trough cleanly defeat the strong enemy VG 2-0, breaking the losing streak. Now standing on this stage, how do you feel now? Can you share it with us?"

Without any unnecessary pause, Chen Zhou held the microphone and regained his inner peace: "I feel very happy. I can win this game. It will make me feel that my persistence in the path of being a professional League of Legends player is worthwhile."

The air in the stadium was quiet for half a second, and then a male fan of an unknown team in the audience took the lead in applauding. The applause was not very enthusiastic, but it was clear.

The story of hard work being rewarded is timeless everywhere.

The reason why people like to hear such stories is because in reality, this is often a luxury item.
